title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (Longue Marche continuation, section II of 'variations sur l'équation des lacets'). Grothendieck works with a profinite group 𝔊 topologically generated by a pair (ρ,σ), with ρ^3=1 and σ^2=1 (see the margin). Such a group is a quotient of the universal one, the profinite completion of Z/3 * Z/2 ≅ PSL(2,Z), which he writes 𝔊^{+∧}_{0,3}. To the pair (𝔊,(ρ,σ)) he attaches several groups:
- B_{ρ,σ}: a group of automorphisms u of 𝔊 adapted to the pair.
- Z_ρ and Z_σ: centraliser- or normaliser-type groups attached to ρ and σ.
- G_{ρ,σ} = B_{ρ,σ}·𝔊.
- Γ_{ρ,σ} and γ_{ρ,σ}.
- S_0M^0_{ρ,σ} and its quotient M_{ρ,σ}, glued from B, Z_ρ, Z_σ and G (eq. 83 on the previous page).

The previous page states a functoriality theorem. A surjection φ: 𝔊→𝔊' sending (ρ,σ) to (ρ',σ') induces a unique homomorphism φ_{SM}: S_0M^0_𝔊 → S_0M^0_{𝔊'}. It comes from compatible maps φ_B, φ_ρ, φ_σ, φ_G. These are subject to the commutative squares (85), 𝔊→G_{ρ,σ}, and (86), u'∘φ = φ∘u for u'=φ_B(u).

This page finishes that statement:
1. The squares (86) determine φ_B from φ.
2. Hence φ_B determines φ_{SM}.
3. Passing to quotients gives (87): φ_M: M_{ρ,σ} → M_{ρ',σ'}.

He then gives a more direct description in terms of 'parameters' (α,β,γ) instead of the earlier coordinates (u,a,b,U). Elements of S_0M^0 are written u_{α,β,γ}, with α,β,γ ∈ 𝔊. The map is simply (88): φ(u_{α,β,γ}) = u_{φ(α),φ(β),φ(γ)}. The parametrisation is thus natural in 𝔊.

This recovers 'the preceding theorems' in a slightly more precise form. The key special case is 𝔊 = 𝔊^{+∧}_{0,3}, the 'universal case', at least universal among groups with ρ^3=σ^2=1, with 𝔊' arbitrary. He decides (89) to swap the roles of 𝔊 and 𝔊' in what follows.

(90) then lists the invariants in the universal case:
- B' = M^{!~}_{0,3}[0]
- γ' = Γ'^~_Q (a Galois/Teichmüller-type profinite group, presumably the GT-like group attached to the (0,3) situation)
- G' = M'^~_{0,3}
- Z'_ρ = M'^~_{0,3}(1/3?) and Z'_σ = M'^~_{0,3}(1/2)
- Γ' = Γ'^~_Q

The struck-out parenthesis noted Z'_ρ ≃ Z'_σ ≃ γ'. The next page draws the consequence S_0M' ≃ S_0M'^~_{0,3}, then treats the modular case 𝔊 = SL(2,Ẑ)/±1.

Purpose: show that the 'multiplier/automorphism' structures attached to a (3,2)-generated profinite group are functorial. In the universal case they are given by a GT/Galois-type group acting on the profinite completion of PSL(2,Z). Every specific quotient (e.g. the modular one) then receives a canonical map from the universal one.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The definitions of B, Z, G, M and of u_{α,β,γ} live on earlier pages, so the correctness of (88) cannot be checked independently here.

The claim in (86) that φ_B is determined by φ needs φ to be surjective (given on the previous page) and needs φ_B to exist at all, i.e. that automorphisms in B_{ρ,σ} descend. The descent condition is implicit in the statement rather than proved on this page.

ideas.what: Functoriality of the automorphism/'multiplier' groups attached to a profinite group with a pair of generators (ρ,σ), ρ^3=σ^2=1, under surjections respecting the generators.
ideas.modern_name: Naturality of characteristic-quotient automorphism groups; descent of automorphisms to characteristic quotients of PSL(2,Z)^
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore in anabelian/GT literature (cf. Lochak–Schneps work on GT acting on PSL2(Z)^ quotients)

ideas.what: Parametrisation of the elements u_{α,β,γ} by triples in 𝔊, with the induced map acting by φ on the parameters (eq. 88).
ideas.modern_name: Functorial parametrisation of generator-preserving automorphisms (GT-type parameters)

ideas.what: Universal case 𝔊 = profinite completion of Z/3*Z/2 ≅ PSL(2,Z)^, with invariants identified with a Galois/Teichmüller-type group Γ'^~_Q.
ideas.modern_name: GT / Gal(Q̄/Q) acting on π_1 of the modular orbifold M_{1,1} (or P^1 minus 3 points with orbifold structure)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses Galois action on the Teichmüller tower and on PSL2(Z)^ in spirit

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine functoriality bookkeeping page inside a long development. The ideas (Galois/GT action on PSL2(Z)^ and its quotients, functoriality under quotients) are known in the later literature. Nothing here appears new beyond notational detail.
transcription_corrections: The group is written as a script G (𝔊, as on the previous page), not 𝔖.
In (90), Z'_ρ = M'^~_{0,3}(...): the argument is illegible/overwritten. By analogy with Z'_σ = M'^~_{0,3}(1/2) and ρ^3=1, it is plausibly (1/3).
The margin reads roughly: 'tout au moins "universel" pour [les quotients ...] de 𝔊 [avec] ρ^3=1, σ^2=1'.
The mark '(8')' near the line 'interchanger le rôle de 𝔊 et 𝔊'' corresponds to (89).
The page number at bottom left is 520 (archive numbering). Grothendieck's own numbering is 563/564 on the neighbouring pages.
